claim: In the matching retail DLL, SkillDataMan.GetSkillData overload token 0x06005262 is an instance method with one parameter named anm_id and an exact 30-byte body. It applies signed bounds to anm_id: values below raw 0 branch to a fallback, values below raw 4188 continue unchanged, and values at or above raw 4188 fall through to the same fallback. The fallback overwrites argument anm_id with raw 0 using starg.s. The method then loads the SkillDataMan.skillData array field (0x04007CF7), indexes it with the resulting anm_id, and returns that element. FACT-0072 pins the direct call to this exact overload after computing raw 2675 + skill_idx.
